description: This file contains source code for handling differences between file states in a Git repository, including diffing functions for files and index states, as well as merge base calculations.

methods.name: int check_removed(const struct cache_entry * ce,struct stat * st)
methods.description: Checks whether a file or directory represented by a cache entry has been removed from the working directory, handling symlinks, directories, and submodules.

methods.name: int match_stat_with_submodule(struct diff_options * diffopt,const struct cache_entry * ce,struct stat * st,unsigned ce_option,unsigned * dirty_submodule)
methods.description: Determines whether a file or submodule has been changed based on stat info, and sets the dirty_submodule flag accordingly.

methods.name: void run_diff_files(struct rev_info * revs,unsigned int option)
methods.description: Performs a diff between the working directory and the index or tree, outputting file differences, handling unmerged stages, sparse directories, and submodules.

methods.name: void diff_index_show_file(struct rev_info * revs,const char * prefix,const struct cache_entry * ce,const struct object_id * oid,int oid_valid,unsigned int mode,unsigned dirty_submodule)
methods.description: Handles the presentation of files that are either added, modified, or deleted in the index diff.

methods.name: int get_stat_data(const struct cache_entry * ce,const struct object_id ** oidp,unsigned int * modep,int cached,int match_missing,unsigned * dirty_submodule,struct diff_options * diffopt)
methods.description: Retrieves stat info for a cache entry, checking if it has changed, and outputs its object id and mode.

methods.name: void show_new_file(struct rev_info * revs,const struct cache_entry * new_file,int cached,int match_missing)
methods.description: Displays a diff entry for a new file, retrieving its stat info if necessary.

methods.name: int show_modified(struct rev_info * revs,const struct cache_entry * old_entry,const struct cache_entry * new_entry,int report_missing,int cached,int match_missing)
methods.description: Displays a diff for a modified file, considering sparse directories and unmerged states.

methods.name: void do_oneway_diff(struct unpack_trees_options * o,const struct cache_entry * idx,const struct cache_entry * tree)
methods.description: Performs a diff between an index entry and a tree entry, handling added, removed, and modified files, with support for sparse directories and conflicts.

methods.name: int diff_cache(struct rev_info * revs,const struct object_id * tree_oid,const char * tree_name,int cached)
methods.description: Diffs a specific tree object against the current index state, parsing the tree and applying the diff logic.

methods.name: void run_diff_index(struct rev_info * revs,unsigned int option)
methods.description: Performs a diff between the current index state and a tree, handling merge bases and updating the revision info accordingly.

methods.name: int do_diff_cache(const struct object_id * tree_oid,struct diff_options * opt)
methods.description: Temporary helper to run diff on a specific tree object with provided options.

methods.name: int index_differs_from(struct repository * r,const char * def,const struct diff_flags * flags,int ita_invisible_in_index)
methods.description: Checks if the current index differs from a specified revision or set of flags.

methods.name: const char * idiff_prefix_cb(struct diff_options * opt UNUSED,void * data)
methods.description: Provides a prefix string for interdiff output.

methods.name: void show_interdiff(const struct object_id * oid1,const struct object_id * oid2,int indent,struct diff_options * diffopt)
methods.description: Displays a diff between two objects with indentation, useful for showing differences between revisions.

methods.name: void diff_get_merge_base(const struct rev_info * revs,struct object_id * mb)
int oneway_diff(const struct cache_entry * const * src,struct unpack_trees_options * o)
